Messages.Body:

Rise of the Nephitali?

Perhaps an even larger question: It there a difference between Anarchs and
Independents? I always assumed they were two seperate sects.

-Vin

Messages.Author: Eric Simon
Messages.Body:
Timlagor <TimSl...@yaMhoo.co.uk> wrote in message news:<MPG.1b1c8872f...@news.eclipse.co.uk>...


Technically it's a subsect of Independent (see rules section 10.4).
This is important because it means that if you use Into the Fire on
merged Dominique, she is no longer Anarch nor Baron of Paris. Note
that this is different from taking an inherently Black Hand vamp (not
a Blooded one) Out of the Frying Pan - they retain their Handedness.
Black Hand is more of an attribute, Anarch is really a subsect.

Oh, and Liason is definitely claimable by Anarchs. I actually
incorporated it into my Jack's Rant deck from the May newsletter -
it's another great reason to use big Anarchs.

Eric Simon
Prince of Chicago
Anarch Newsletter Writer
